jobs.title: Sr Product Owner - AI & Analytics
jobs.description:
Department:
Technology

Our Company Promise

We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.

Job Description:
Job Summary - Serve as the Customer proxy, and responsible for working with Product Management and other stakeholders—including other product owners and other teams—to define and prioritize the Team Backlog so that the solution effectively addresses program priorities while maintaining technical integrity. Attend product management meetings, planning, and backlog/vision refinement sessions. Serve as a mentor to the APO and PO.

Responsibilities - Provide innovation and the end-to-end launch of integrated solutions/products across multiple Agile Teams
- Collaborate with Business Partners and Product Managers to co-develop a roadmap and drive products and features from concept to launch in a fast-paced environment across multiple Agile Teams
- Work with senior stakeholders and customers across the organization to inform the product vision, strategy, features, and prioritization
- Translate product roadmap features into well-defined product requirements including features, user stories, and acceptance test criteria across multiple products or complex solutions
- Turn data insights into products with actionable outcomes to the ultimate customer
- Oversee the design, construction, and implementation of integrated solutions ensuring functionality meets business requirements
- Coach and mentor other Product Owners across multiple Agile Teams to build, refine, prioritize and maintain their Team backlogs
- Review, approve, and drive iteration content by prioritizing user stories and accept user stories as complete
- Define and prioritize solutions to complex issues and effectively communicate dependencies, risks, issues and cope for complex solutions
- Coach and mentor Product Owners and Scrum Masters in the successful delivery of Scrum ceremonies such as iteration planning, iteration reviews, and demos
- May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities - Ability to make decisions independently and demonstrate skills to support, guide, and mentor other Product Owners in the same business domain
- Ability to understand technical issues across multiple business systems and how business areas interact in order to drive toward the best solutions
- Ability to be analytical and problem solve with a high attention to detail
- Ability to show initiative by anticipating risks, issues and opportunities, and escalating them accordingly, while mentoring and coaching
- Skilled in presentation, facilitation, communication, and negotiation across multiple stakeholders and levels in the organization
- Ability to search for opportunities, focus on business value and the Return On Investment and act proactively on possible risks and threats
- Ability to effectively manage complex tasks that are not well defined
- Ability to balance priority, risk, value, learning opportunities and dependencies and effectively uses product / Team backlog to manage them
- Ability to effectively communicate complex problems, risks, progress, or new ideas to diverse Stakeholders and influence direction
- Knowledge of industry trends and new technologies in order to provide innovative product guidance to the Business or Product Manager
- Expertise in Agile including the value and principles, and how they are applied in enterprise environments

Education - Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field and/or equivalent formal training

Experience - Required: Advanced-level experience, seasoned and specialized knowledge in: - Agile and Scrum software development methodologies
- Safe Agile Framework
- Domain related to finance
- Power Point skills , KPI Reporting and Dashboard Management
- Business analysis, project management or software development delivering enterprise products and solutions

- 5-7 years of relevant work-related experience

Other Qualifications - Must meet confidentiality expectations as to confidential, proprietary and sensitive Company information
- Ability to work extended hours as needed

Southwest Airlines is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
Please print/save this job description because it won't be available after you apply.

jobs.title: Product Owner Global -  Observability Accelerators & AI
jobs.description:
Department:
Technology

Our Company Promise

We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.

Job Description:
About Us

At Southwest Airlines, we believe that flying should feel like freedom. For over 50 years, we’ve been connecting people to what matters most with low fares, legendary hospitality, and a heart for service. Our culture is built on the principles of fun, friendliness, and family, making us one of the most admired workplaces in the world.

If you’re passionate about making a difference, love working in a fast-paced environment, and want to help millions of travelers reach their destinations with a smile, Southwest Airlines is the place for you. Here,  your career can truly take flight.

Job Summary
As a Product Owner – Observability Accelerators & AI, you'll help shape the future of how Southwest monitors, troubleshoots, and improves technology reliability across the enterprise. You'll join the Observability Accelerators & AI Pod, a Team that creates reusable observability products and capabilities that help development and operations Teams onboard faster, resolve issues more efficiently, and deliver more reliable technology experiences. In this role, you'll serve as the voice of the Customer and own the Team backlog, partnering closely with Engineers, Architects, and stakeholders to define, prioritize, and deliver solutions spanning OpenTelemetry deployment patterns, dashboard generators, migration tooling, AI-agent telemetry, anomaly detection, AI-assisted investigations, and root-cause analysis. By balancing business priorities, technical strategy, and user needs, you'll help accelerate adoption of observability best practices, reduce Mean Time to Recover, and advance Southwest's AI-powered operational capabilities. Your work will directly influence how Technology Teams across the Company operate at scale while providing opportunities to drive enterprise-wide impact, foster innovation, and contribute to Southwest's continued digital transformation.

Responsibilities - Prepare backlog for PI Planning and decide which work items become part of the team backlog
- Serve as the customer proxy
- Build, refine, prioritize, and maintain the team backlog
- Partner in Scrum ceremonies such as iteration planning, iteration reviews, and demos
- Help create user stories and define acceptance criteria
- Review and accept user stories as complete
- Contribute to vision and program Backlog
- Meet with stakeholders to ensure features and subsequent stories meet expectations
- Drive iteration content by prioritizing user stories
- May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities - Ability to make decisions with minimal guidance and oversight
- Ability to be organized with strong attention to detail and capable of coordinating multiple viewpoints into a single message
- Ability to understand technical issues
- Skilled in analytics and problem solving with a high attention to detail
- Ability to anticipate risks, issues and opportunities, and escalate them accordingly
- Skilled in presentation, facilitation, communication, and negotiation
- Ability to be comfortable and articulate in challenging change management scenarios, knowing when to insert self and when to fade back
- Solid knowledge in Agile including the value and principles, and how they are applied in enterprise environments

Education - Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field and/or equivalent formal training

Experience - Required: Intermediate-level experience, fully functioning broad knowledge in: - Agile and Scrum software development methodologies
- Business analysis, project management or software development delivering enterprise products and solutions
- 2-5 years of relevant work-related experience
- AWS
- APIs
- CI/CD; Infrastructure as Code
- Telemetry platforms
- Agile / SAFe

- Preferred: - OpenTelemetry
- Grafana; Prometheus
- CloudWatch
- SRE tooling; incident-management workflows; AI-agent products
- Jira; Confluence; Apptio Targetprocess

Other Qualifications - Must meet confidentiality expectations as to confidential, proprietary and sensitive Company information
- Ability to work extended hours as needed

Southwest Airlines is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
